rule: auto iff 2+ sources agree (majority), exactly one source + MoFAGA corroborates (mofaga), MoFAGA verbatim-equals a vote (mofaga-exact), all votes converge under neKey with MoFAGA on the same key (mofaga-unanimous, authority orthography adopted), or MoFAGA breaks a genuine raw split (mofaga-tiebreak); one MoFAGA row matching 2+ conflicts downgrades both (mofaga-ambiguous); normalized convergence without MoFAGA coverage stays human (normalized-unanimous, converged key recorded)

decisions.name: Diprung
decisions.evidence: MoFAGA Khotang list (8 palikas) does not include Diprung. CBS has 'दिप्रुङ्ग' (dental द + chandrabindu) but romanization 'Diprung' and abinrimal 'डिप्रुङ' (retroflex ड + anusvara) agree on retroflex ड. Retroflex is standard for 'Di' in Nepali toponyms. Adopting abinrimal orthography.

decisions.name: Jante Dhunga
decisions.evidence: MoFAGA Khotang list (8 palikas) does not include Jante Dhunga. Three-way split: abin='जानतेढुङ्गा', sag='जन्तेढुंगा', cbs='जन्तेढुङ्गा'. CBS 'जन्तेढुङ्गा' follows standard orthography: जन्ते (jante) + ढुङ्गा (dhunga). Anusvara on ढुङ्गा is correct for 'ng' before 'g'. Adopting CBS.

decisions.name: Birgunj
decisions.evidence: Birgunj is a Metropolitan City (महानगरपालिका) but absent from MoFAGA Parsa (13 palikas, no metropolitan). Three-way raw split: abin='वीरगन्ज' (anusvara), sag='बिरगंज' (anusvara + बि), cbs='बिरगन्ज' (anusvara + बि). Official GoN spelling per MoFAGA gazette: 'वीरगञ्ज' with chandrabindu (ँ) for the nasal in 'गञ्ज'. Retroflex वीर + चन्द्रबिन्दु is the authoritative form. Adopting canonical MoFAGA orthography not present in any source.

decisions.name: Phatuwa Bijayapur
decisions.evidence: MoFAGA Rautahat (14 palikas) does not include Phatuwa Bijayapur. Three-way split: abin='विजयपुर फटुवा' (reversed word order), sag='फतुवाबिजयपुर' (conjoined), cbs='फतुवा बिजयपुर' (separate words, बि for 'bi'). CBS form follows standard: फतुवा (phatuwa) + बिजयपुर (bijayapur) with dental बि. Adopting CBS.

decisions.name: Shankharapur
decisions.evidence: MoFAGA Kathmandu (9 palikas) omits Shankharapur (known municipality). Three-way: abin='शंखरापुर' (no nasal), sag='शङ्खरापुर' (anusvara on शङ्ख), cbs='शंङ्खरापुर' (double nasal). The cluster 'ङ्ख' requires anusvara on the first consonant (शङ्ख). Sagautam5 'शङ्खरापुर' is orthographically correct. Adopting sagautam5.

decisions.evidence: MoFAGA Baitadi (8 palikas) does not include Dilasaini. Two-way: abin='डिलासैनी' (short इ), cbs='डीलासैनी' (long ई). 'Dila' = डिल (short i) is standard; long ई in CBS appears to be a transcription error. Adopting abinrimal.

decisions.name: Bitthadchir
decisions.evidence: MoFAGA Bajhang (10 palikas) does not include Bitthadchir. Two-way: sag='वित्थडचिर' (वि), cbs='बित्थडचिर' (बि). 'Bittha' = बित्था (bilabial ब) not विथ्था (labiodental व). CBS 'बित्थडचिर' matches standard phonology. Adopting CBS.
